impediments.name: Broken similarToTitles references touching a 5★ read

impediments.fix: Correct each reference to the exact title string in the dataset (Broken References tab, sorted with these first).

impediments.name: Non-canonical theme usage
impediments.description: 156 uses of themes outside the canonical vocabulary (chiefly "legal"/"courtroom") — these don't contribute to themeBonus scoring at all.
impediments.fix: Remap to canonical themes, or promote frequently-used ones (see promotion candidates) to the canonical list in CLAUDE.md and the engine.

impediments.name: Already-read books still in a candidate pool
impediments.description: 5 book(s) Bill has already read and rated are still sitting in a candidate pool — he could be recommended a book he's already finished.
impediments.fix: Remove these entries from their candidate pool file(s).

impediments.fix: Correct each reference to the exact title string in the dataset.

impediments.name: Self-referential entries

impediments.fix: Replace with a genuinely different similar title or author.
